title: i18n(plugin-security): ship the security objects, built-in permission sets and positions in all eleven platform languages
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D7v5H7BaFmL7sUCoN7tSxhm)_

domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cya5ej5GQV86RPbRPK

Part of #30512 — package 7 of 11 (`@objectstack/plugin-security`). The card stays open: settings, sharing, approvals and platform-objects follow, and the last PR of the series makes the bundle check read the platform locale table.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 安全插件的对象（用户权限集指派、用户职位指派等）的名称、字段、帮助和校验提示，加上内置权限集的名称与说明、内置职位（平台管理员、组织所有者等）的名称与说明，补上繁中、阿语、法语、巴葡、俄语、德语、韩语 7 种，与平台语言表的 11 种一致。
- **为什么改：** 平台语言表要求每个界面带齐 11 种语言；这是第 3 期按包补齐的第 7 个包。用这 7 种语言的管理员在「设置 → 权限集 / 职位」里看到的不再是英文。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加翻译数据和注册行，不动逻辑、schema、接口；原有 4 种语言一字未改。唯一的测试改动是职位改名一致性测试多扫 6 种语言（覆盖变宽，没有放宽任何断言）。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `src/translations/index.ts`（按表标签注册，zh-CN 在 zh-Hant 前）、`permission-sets.ts` 与 `builtin-positions.ts`（手写的两张表），再看 `position-rename-consistency.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证：** `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --filter=security` 输出 `plugins/plugin-security in sync`；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test` 全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- Seven new locales for the security package under the platform locale table's tags (`zh-Hant`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `de`, `ko`): each a `TAG.objects.generated.ts` with all 60 object leaves plus its `TAG.source-hashes.generated.ts`, written by the repo's own `os i18n extract --fill=default --source-hashes` and served through `withSourceFallback` like the existing three. `zh-CN` stays ahead of `zh-Hant` in `index.ts`.
- The two hand-written tables gain an entry per new locale: `permission-sets.ts` (label and description of the nine built-in permission sets) and `builtin-positions.ts` (label and description of the seven built-in positions). Both are registered as each locale's `permissions` / `positions` group, and their header sentence now says "every locale" instead of "three entries".
- The extract command in `scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts` lists the seven tags and its merge baseline imports the seven bundles, so `check:i18n` covers them from this PR on.

## Tests

- `builtin-positions.test.ts` and `objects/permission-set-descriptions.test.ts` already iterate every locale of `SecurityTranslations`, so each new locale is held to the existing rules with no test edit: exactly the built-in names, no two labels alike, no English copy, no position id in the text, and the served `GET /meta/position` overlay.
- `position-rename-consistency.test.ts` extends its stale-word scan (no "role" wording left on the renamed objects) to `zh-Hant`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `de` and `ko`. Coverage widens; no assertion changed. Arabic is not added: its word for "role" (دور) is also the word in بدوره ("in turn"), which a correct help text on `sys_user_position.delegated_from` uses, so a pattern for it would flag correct text.

## Acceptance notes

- **Quality bar (#17508 / PR #19345):** every leaf written for the reader; placeholders, code spans and identifiers byte-identical, checked mechanically per leaf against `en` (key set, `{{holes}}`, `{holes}`, backtick spans, angle tokens: all seven locales OK, zero diffs). Arabic is RTL prose with identifiers left in Latin script. `zh-Hant` was checked character by character against OpenCC's Traditional (Taiwan) conversion: no Simplified-only character remains.
- **Leaves equal to English, on purpose:** one, `de` `sys_user_position.fields.position.label` = `Position` (the German word). The extractor records it as a source copy in `de.source-hashes.generated.ts`.
- The English source of `sys_user_position.fields.delegated_from.help` carries the Chinese term `(职务代理)`; every locale keeps it as `es-ES` already does. Not changed here (the source text belongs to the object, not to this bundle).
- No cross-locale coincidence: `check:i18n-stale-fill` passes with the baseline untouched.
- Carried unchanged from the released handover commit `ff28e790` (session `session_01Utp6Cai5CRdAs4u9gTipWU`): the patch id of this PR's diff equals that commit's (`446fab73`). The serial row "after #30208 lands" was cleared by the seat: #30208's server rows that touch this package landed in PR #30551, an ancestor of this branch.
